hero.headline: Play together. Build together.
hero.body: The Token Game is more than coins — it's a living community of collectors, traders, and zone champions. Find your zone, claim your identity, and connect with players across all 16 editions.

zoneHubs.headline: Zone community hubs
zoneHubs.body: Every edition zone has its own community. Join the hub for your zone to get zone-specific news, seasonal drops, and War Room strategy.

playerIdentity.headline: Your player identity
playerIdentity.body: Your Tienko Wallet is your passport across the entire universe. Every coin you hold, every quest you complete, and every zone you conquer is permanently recorded on-chain.

features.title: Tienko Wallet
features.description: Your on-chain identity. Holds all coins, XP, and achievements across every zone.

features.title: RPG Character
features.description: Choose your class, unlock abilities, and level up through the five character tiers.

features.title: Journey Stages
features.description: Progress through 7 journey stages from Newcomer to Legend. Each stage unlocks new privileges.

features.title: Leaderboard Rank
features.description: Your coin holdings rank you globally and within each zone. Top holders earn seasonal rewards.

features.title: Artifact Status
features.description: Artifact Coins are permanent on-chain trophies. Holders are permanently listed in the Hall of Legends.

features.title: Season Rewards
features.description: Complete seasonal objectives to earn exclusive coins, USGC bonuses, and zone badges.

socialHubs.headline: Connect with the community
socialHubs.body: Join the conversation across all platforms. Get alpha, share strategies, and stay ahead of seasonal drops.

channels.name: Discord
channels.description: The main hub. Zone channels, announcements, trading floor, and live events.

channels.name: Grid Node
channels.description: Decentralised community infrastructure. Node operators earn rewards for hosting zone data.

channels.name: Solchat.me
channels.description: On-chain messaging for Solana wallets. Chat directly with other players wallet-to-wallet.

channels.name: X / Twitter
channels.description: Breaking news, seasonal announcements, and community highlights.

channels.name: Telegram
channels.description: Fast updates, price alerts, and community polls. The quickest way to stay in the loop.

hallOfLegends.headline: Hall of Legends
hallOfLegends.body: The top collectors, zone champions, and Artifact Coin holders. Updated every season.
hallOfLegends.comingSoonText: Season 1 rankings will be revealed at season close. Keep collecting.

cta.headline: Ready to find your zone?
cta.body: Pick an edition, collect your first coin, and join the zone community. Your journey starts with one token.
